title: When Your Parachute Fails - Book Launch and Live Talk
desc:

Lana shows how to move forward when we’re still afraid. title: 2ND ANNUAL BRGHTLIGHTS CHRISTMAS SHOW w/ CHLORINE, redhed, Paolo
desc:
Downstairs · Fri Dec 11, 2026 · 7:29 AM
THE 2nd ANNUAL BRGHTLIGHTS CHRISTMAS SHOW. $5 from every ticket sold benefiting The Fort York Food Bank. Live at The Monarch Tavern. Welcome to THE 2ND ANNUAL BRGHTLIGHTS CHRISTMAS SHOW featuring THE BRGHTLIGHTS, CHLORINE, redhed, and a DJ set by Paolo from Sofiacide! Join us at the Monarch Tavern on December 11th, 2025 at 7:30 PM for an unforgettable night of music and holiday cheer. $5 from every ticket sold goes towards benefiting the Fort York Food Bank. Don't miss out on this incredible event! THE BRGHTLIGHTS are a four-piece rock n roll band from Woodbridge. Sonically adventurous and lyrically earnest; equally inspired by the songwriting of Bruce Springsteen and Robert Smith as they are by the production and arrangements of Oasis, My Chemical Romance, and Burial. CHLORINE is a 5-piece band from Toronto that blends elements from the 2000s indie rock revival with lyrics tinted by relationships and regret to create a familiar yet refreshing sound that channels the spirit of Arctic Monkeys, The Killers, Inhaler and The Cure. redhed is a five-piece storm of chaos and charm from Woodbridge. Their sound jumps from smooth chords to explosive drums and distorted solos, topped with lyrics about being young, reckless, and learning on the fly. It’s loud, fun, messy, and surprisingly heartfelt—like the soundtrack to your best bad decisions. Paolo from Sofiacide is a human italian male.

desc:
Downstairs · Tue Jan 19, 2027 · 7:00 PM
Songwriters Victoria Rose and Stone Filipczak have a pact, a devotion to each other and to the music of @. In their solo existence, Victoria works as a beekeeper and Stone as a self-taught computer programmer, but when they get together, they become a singular, avant-garde song force. The East Coast house-show circuit first brought them into each other's orbit. Both Victoria and Stone are long time participants in the D.I.Y. music world, with their own separate histories in basement noise shows, warehouses and all ages spaces (Victoria has several records under the name Brittle Brian, and Stone has most recently gone by the pseudonym E.R. Visit). Over time, the two began collaborating long distance, and soon developed the @ formula – half Victoria songs, half Stone songs, with each filling in the cracks of the other’s compositions. On their new album Autosmile, the band’s first with the legendary indie label 4AD, @ have harnessed their unique process to reimagine the psychedelic folk tradition as an undeniably contemporary art form. @ are a coalition, a team, a two-headed cat, and their collaboration has led them, once again, to fascinating and timeless results. This is an 19+ event Presented by Not Dead Yet. title: ZI: Toronto Premiere
desc:
Paradise Theatre
Mon Nov 30, 2026 · 6:00 PM
In Hong Kong, a young violinist named Zi (Michelle Mao) struggles with her memory while enigmatic visions of her future self haunt her. She meets a stranger named Elle (Haley Lu Richardson), whom she recognizes from these visions. Together they walk Hong Kong’s streets and are joined by Min (Jin Ha), a researcher at the local neurology center. As day turns to night and night turns to dawn, Zi must reconcile the increasingly overlapping realities of her past, present, and future selves. The film is the latest feature from Kogonada, director of After Yang and Columbus. Tickets are available.

title: Curator’s Talk: The Value of Beads
desc:
Bata Shoe Museum
Mon Nov 30, 2026 · 6:30 PM
Director & Senior Curator Elizabeth Semmelhack presents “Time, Labour, and the Value of Beads,” a special curator’s talk held in connection with Brilliant: The Art of Beaded Footwear Around the World. The exhibition brings together more than 85 beaded footwear objects from Africa, Europe, South Asia, Turtle Island and Western Asia, exploring over 400 years of craftsmanship and cultural expression. This talk explores beadwork traditions from around the world and their role as markers of wealth, prestige, and cultural meaning. Tickets are available for purchase through the museum's website.
